title: v2.3.0
summary: Highlights Background Subagents by Default: Subagents now return immediately, continue in the background, and report back whenever they become idle. You can keep working in the parent session while multiple subagents run concurrently. (#63382) Quieter Transcripts by Default: The TUI now summarizes each run of tool calls and thoughts into one collapsible activity row, so the answer is easier to follow. To see every step again, set Verbosity to medium or high in settings, or set session.verbosity

summary: Minor Changes c0211e9: The CLI now authenticates every request with your login's access token instead of a stored API key. e2b auth login opens https://e2b.dev/auth/cli (or https://$E2B_DOMAIN/auth/cli). The E2B_DOCS_BASE override is removed. Access tokens are refreshed automatically before they expire, including during long-running commands such as sandbox logs --follow, sandbox metrics --follow and an attached sandbox create session.
